subject: English
passage: Students of Renaissance art will ______ numerous influences from classical mythology in Botticelli's paintings, including his famous depictions of Venus drawn from ancient Roman sources.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation: Choice D is the best answer. The convention being tested here is punctuation between a verb and object. No punctuation is needed between the verb ("recognize") and its object ("the numerous influences..."). The object helps complete the idea of the verb—in this case, it explains what students of Renaissance art will recognize—and any punctuation between the two results in an ungrammatical sentence.
